text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is finally here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before the race, Rice Shower reveals to me that she's afraid she'll disappoint her fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the past, all she would have done was quiver in fear, but now…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Remembering the joy on her fans' faces and in their cheers instills within her enough confidence for her to take on the race.
